DEMONSTRATED WITHIN MINUTES OF THE RULING: cargo build -p decision-ledger was silently offloaded by the rch wrapper to contabo-2 and returned 'ELF 64-bit LSB pie executable, x86-64 ... for GNU/Linux 3.2.0' on an arm64 Darwin host; every invocation failed with 'cannot execute binary file' and all five decision records silently did not land. Rebuilt with RCH_CARGO_WRAPPER_BYPASS=1 in 3.43s -> 'Mach-O 64-bit executable arm64'. So the ruling is not theoretical: the default build path already produces unrunnable artifacts for this host, and NE-001 in NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE.md already records that an offloaded exit code is not a verdict about the local target. To wire: .github/workflows/gate.yml is runs-on: ubuntu-latest at every job, so a darwin artifact lane needs a macos runner or a local-Mac step.
